needs_review.issue: International regions listed but no staff enumerated
needs_review.finding: donate.campusoutreach.org/giving-search directory lists 17 international regions: Athens (Greece), Belo Horizonte (Brazil), Brisbane (Australia), Cape Town (South Africa), Chiang Mai (Thailand), Christchurch (New Zealand), Dunedin (New Zealand), Edinburgh (Scotland), Guadalajara (Mexico), Johannesburg (South Africa), Khon Kaen (Thailand), Lima (Peru), London (UK), Lusaka (Zambia), Manila (Philippines), Monterrey (Mexico), Udon Thani (Thailand)
needs_review.evidence: Search result from site:donate.campusoutreach.org regions list query showed comprehensive listing of all regional operations in the giving-search directory
needs_review.recommendation: International regions are present but page-fetching is blocked; enumeration agent cannot access individual staff details from search snippets alone. These regions confirm depth in the give-search directory but require direct page access to extract staff member names. For future waves, consider whether orchestrator verification searches should target these international staff pages directly.

needs_review.issue: M-Z cities without verified staff pages or insufficient indexing
needs_review.finding: Domain searches for Milwaukee (no results), Nashville (conashville.org not indexed), New Orleans (coneworleans.org not indexed), Philadelphia (cophiladelphia.org not indexed), Phoenix (cophoenix.org not indexed), Pittsburgh (no indexed pages found), Tampa (cotampa.org not indexed), Richmond (corichmond.org not indexed), and several other M-Z cities returned no indexed results or redirects to other regional hubs
needs_review.evidence: Site-specific queries for: site:cophiladelphia.org, site:cophoenix.org, site:conashville.org, site:conapoleon.org, site:coneworleans.org, site:corichmond.org, site:cotampa.org all returned zero results for Campus Outreach staff
needs_review.recommendation: Either these regional domains do not exist or are not being indexed by search engines. Some cities (Nashville area) may operate under Memphis; some may be under construction or not yet launched. The confirmed pattern holds for Memphis, Minneapolis, San Diego, and Central Florida but appears to have gaps in coverage for other M-Z cities. Suggest checking the main Campus Outreach locations page or contacting headquarters for complete regional listing.

needs_review.finding: coraleigh.org redirects to Charlotte operations (cocharlotte.org), indicating Raleigh is served by Campus Outreach Charlotte rather than a standalone regional site
